newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks bounce back with 7.7 pct gains.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks bounce back with 7.7 pct gains.

text.p: Dhaka stocks bounced back to close up by nearly 7.7 percent halting a lingering bear run, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index rose 82.63 points or 7.68 percent to 1,157.58 on turnover of 34.7 million taka. Gainers led losers by 111 to three.

The trading on the bourse was delayed by half an hour after the traders in the kerb market held a protest rally and locked the door of the DSE. Police later drove away the protesters who were demanding resignation of Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria and steps by the government to stop falling prices.
"The market started gaining from early hours after the sellers suddenly withdrew, creating liquidity shortfall," said one broker.
He said: "I don't have any good explation for such a sudden price hike. But this could be an effort of the market players to restore the morale of the traders in the kerb market."
Beximco Pharma rose 13.0 taka to 150.7, Chittagong Cement gained 173 to 1,904 and Monno Fabrics was up 13.23 to 149.5.
